name: Extreme Power House
old_description: XPH is your home for BMW, Audi, Ford Mustang, VW, Porsche and Nissan GTR aftermarket parts. We offer the best prices on ECU tunes, air intakes, front mount intercoolers, charge pipes, downpipes, axle back and catback exhausts. about:
Extreme Power House operates from Las Vegas, Nevada, serving as an online retailer of aftermarket performance parts for European and American sports cars. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The business distributes a range of bolt-on performance components including ECU tunes, cold-air intake systems, front-mount intercoolers, charge pipes, downpipes, and axle-back and cat-back exhaust systems. Its website catalog is organized by vehicle platform, with deep coverage of BMW 1, 2, and 3 Series models (including M variants) and additional sections for Audi, Ford Mustang, Volkswagen, Porsche, and Nissan GT-R applications. Brands carried include Active Autowerke, among others. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

The company targets automotive aftermarket customers ranging from individual enthusiasts to professional repair and performance shops. Concrete examples from the catalog show fitments for BMW N54/N55/S55/B58 engines, Audi and VW turbocharged models, Ford Mustang EcoBoost and V8 platforms, Porsche 911/718 variants, and the Nissan GT-R VR38 platform.

Extreme Power House emphasizes competitive pricing and service as its primary differentiators, stating it offers the best prices on its core product lines and highlighting outstanding customer support.
